# Astera Loader plugin header

`al_plugin.h`: the Astera Loader plugin API (1.8; the mod uses "al.d3d12" 1.0,
"al.hooks" 1.0, "al.game" 1.0 and, since 0.32.0, "al.input" 1.0 for NVIDIA's PC
Latency ping), copied unchanged from the Astera Loader repository
(`D:\mh world modding\AsteraLoader\include\al\al_plugin.h`), commit
`e33d0436581851d74443994fe6cecf9550f8f690` (Astera Loader 0.2.4-dev). API 1.8 is
in every Astera Loader since v0.2.0-dev.1, so the required 0.2.2 provides it.
Before 0.32.0: API 1.4, commit `81a5b215acae9ea38ea5db8ac9dd57123f62e17a`.
MIT licence, Astera Loader project (`LICENSE`, copied from its repository).
Update by copying the new header and recording the commit here.

Astera Loader was called CMFM until 2026-10-09; CMFM is now its menu plugin.
